name: dsh-comsol
description: COMSOL Multiphysics workflows for DSH, two skills in one bundle: comsol-dsh (open a model in the desktop, edit parameters, rebuild the mesh, tune the solver, run steady or time-dependent studies with live progress, load results into the desktop plot, evaluate and export) on the bundled comsol-mcp engine, plus cfd-web3d (turn CFD results into web 3D - native glTF/GLB export, streamline tubes, three.js viewer). Toggle the plugin to enable/disable both skills everywhere.
